moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio catalog-game-combat-damage-numbers, written here): px @320x200. On the hit frame (0.62 s; second hit 1.42 s, x +24 px) the number appears above the target: scale 0.3 → 1.35 in 160 ms outCubic, then 1.35 → 1 in 160 ms outCubic; rises 26 px over 1.0 s outCubic; fades 700-1050 ms. Target knocks back 7 px (60 ms sine out, back over 390 ms outCubic) and flashes light ink 80 % → 0 in 120 ms; 7-dot burst to 16 px (300 ms) at the contact. A projectile travels 320 ms linear before each hit. Params: hitAt: lúc trúng (0.62 s) · rise: quãng bay lên (26 px) · peak: cỡ vọt (1.35) · life: thời gian sống (1.05 s) · knock: đẩy lùi mục tiêu (7 px). Scale 0.3 → 1.35 → 1 (160 ms each, ease-out cubic), rises 26 px over 1 s, fades 0.7–1.05 s; the target knocks back and flashes, and a projectile flies 320 ms before each hit.
